ios.desc:
Take control of your money with Ghostbill, the simple and powerful app designed to make personal finance stress-free. Whether you want to track spending, manage bills, or grow your savings, Ghostbill keeps everything organized in one place.

Key Features:

1.) Home Dashboard – Get a clear overview of your spending and financial health at a glance.
2.) Receipt Scanning – Snap a photo of any receipt to instantly log expenses without manual entry.
3.) Smart Transaction Tracking – Every purchase is automatically categorized so you always know where your money goes.
4.) Recurring Payments & Subscriptions – Never miss a bill or lose track of subscriptions again with smart reminders.
5.) Savings Goals – Watch your savings grow with simple progress tracking.
6.) Detailed Analytics – Gain insights into your spending habits with clean charts and easy-to-read reports.
7.) Export Data to CSV - Stay organized and export all your expense and income data into CSV format. 

GhostBill is designed to make money management simple, smart, and effortless. Whether you’re building better habits, managing subscriptions, or working toward savings goals, GhostBill helps you stay on top of it all.

Download GhostBill today and start building the financial habits that bring you peace of mind.
